```{r}
#| label: papers-setup
#| include: false
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

db_path <- here("cv-app-test", "cv.db")
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), db_path)
papers <- dbReadTable(con, "papers_in_progress")
dbDisconnect(con)

# Status → badge class + label mapping
classify_status <- function(status) {
  s <- tolower(status)
  if (grepl("presented|conference.*present", s)) {
    list(class = "progress", label = "Presented")
  } else if (grepl("submission|near submission", s) && grepl("conference", s)) {
    list(class = "review", label = "Conference Submission")
  } else if (grepl("journal submission|preparation for journal", s)) {
    list(class = "rnr", label = "Near Submission")
  } else if (grepl("in progress|being performed|in preparation", s)) {
    list(class = "draft", label = "In Progress")
  } else {
    list(class = "draft", label = status)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: papers-render
#| output: asis

if (is.null(papers) || nrow(papers) == 0) {
  cat("*No working papers currently on file.*\n")
} else {
  
  # Detect whether abstract column exists
  has_abstract <- "abstract" %in% names(papers)
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(papers))) {
    
    title   <- papers$articleTitle[i]
    authors <- papers$authors[i]
    status  <- papers$status[i]
    abstract_text <- if (has_abstract && !is.na(papers$abstract[i])) {
      papers$abstract[i]
    } else {
      NULL
    }
    
    badge <- classify_status(status)
    
    # Paper card
    cat('<div class="working-paper-card">\n')
    
    # Header: title + badge
    cat('<div class="wp-header">\n')
    cat(sprintf('<div class="wp-title">%s</div>\n', title))
    cat(sprintf('<span class="status-badge %s">%s</span>\n',
                badge$class, badge$label))
    cat('</div>\n')
    
    # Authors
    if (!is.na(authors) && nchar(trimws(authors)) > 0) {
      cat(sprintf('<div class="wp-authors">%s</div>\n', authors))
    }
    
    # Status detail
    if (!is.na(status) && nchar(trimws(status)) > 0) {
      cat(sprintf('<div class="wp-target"><em>%s</em></div>\n', status))
    }
    
    # Abstract
    if (!is.null(abstract_text)) {
      cat('<details class="wp-abstract-toggle">\n')
      cat('<summary>Abstract</summary>\n')
      cat(sprintf('<div class="wp-abstract-preview">%s</div>\n', abstract_text))
      cat('</details>\n')
    } else {
      cat('<div class="wp-abstract-preview" style="color:#999;font-style:italic;">',
          'Abstract coming soon.</div>\n')
    }
    
    cat('</div>\n\n')
    
    if (i < nrow(papers)) cat('<hr style="margin:2rem 0;border-color:#e0e0e0;">\n\n')
  }
}
```
